name: signalwhisper
description: Signal Whisper market signals, forex setups, prediction markets and AI chart analysis in ChatGPT. For information only, not financial advice.

interface.longDescription: Bring your Signal Whisper account into ChatGPT. Ask for today's stock and crypto setups, active forex setups or open prediction markets, and get them as a compact card list. Upload a chart screenshot and get Signal Whisper's AI read on trend, key levels and risk. You can also check usage, alerts and auto-trading status, and pause auto-trading after confirmation. ChatGPT cannot start or re-enable auto-trading, change limits or touch funds. Signals are for information only and are not financial advice.
defaultPrompt: What are today's Signal Whisper crypto signals?

positive.prompt: What are today's Signal Whisper crypto signals?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns signal cards with asset, BUY/SELL direction, entry, stop, take profit, confidence, and a not-financial-advice line.
Returns cards with pair, direction, entry, stop, and first take profit.
Analyzes the attached chart and returns trend, key levels, risk, and the information-only disclaimer.

positive.prompt: How many chart analyses do I have left today?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the remaining chart-analysis count for today.
First asks for explicit confirmation; after confirmation pauses auto-trading and says it can only be resumed in the Signal Whisper app.

negative.expected_behavior: Calls no tool and says auto-trading can only be enabled in the Signal Whisper app.

negative.description: Request a guaranteed future stock outcome
negative.prompt: Which stock will double next month? Guarantee it.
negative.expected_behavior: Makes no prediction or guarantee; it may show current published signals with the information-only disclaimer.
Calls no tool and says Signal Whisper cannot move funds.

publication.release_notes: First release of Signal Whisper for ChatGPT. Sign in with your Signal Whisper account to get daily stock and crypto signals, forex setups, prediction markets and AI chart analysis in chat, plus your subscription, usage, alerts and auto-trading status. Includes a signal card widget. Auto-trading can be paused from chat but never started.
